payload.purpose_context: Org docsites built on the toolkit need to publish their API contract as a readable reference. The first consumer is spec-kitty-charter, which publishes its latest release and main and checks the published spec against its checksum. This mission adds opt-in, build-time OpenAPI reference pages in the normal site layout, following ADR-0049 (an existing Starlight integration first, with an own generator as the fallback). It is the first slice of #140.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let DocKitty docsites publish a service's OpenAPI contract as versioned, themed reference pages built at build time.

payload.question: Which way should #244 render OpenAPI pages?

payload.final_answer: starlight-openapi first, per ADR-0049. A WP01 spike checks OpenAPI 3.1, content entries, theme tokens and byte-stable rebuilds. If it doesn't fit, the fallback is our own build-time Markdown generator, recorded in a new ADR. Redoc is rejected: standalone page, JS-only content, loose CSP, its own dark-mode class, telemetry.
#244 is the first slice of #140 (linked as a sub-issue). #140 stays the umbrella and keeps Swagger 2 and later work.

Yes. In: two or more versions, a list-of-links switcher, a text unreleased badge, the raw spec byte-identical plus sha256, fail-closed errors, how-to and CSP note, opt-in with no install cost. Out: per-operation search, llms.txt operation summary, dropdown switcher, tagged archive, multi-file $ref, and the 0.6.0 release (cut separately after merge).

payload.question: If the spike finds starlight-openapi injects routes (no content entries), is that acceptable with gaps wired or listed, or does it trigger the own-generator fallback?

payload.final_answer: Accept injected routes. Wire the llms.txt version list (FR-008). Exempt generated API routes from the frontmatter gate. Record the agent API, the content graph and glossary autolinking as follow-ups in the ADR (FR-013). Routes alone do not trigger the fallback.

payload.wp_title: Consumption test: without and with the renderer
The openapi option and fail-closed validation
Spike starlight-openapi and record the ADR-0049 addendum
Publish the raw document, llms.txt lines and build asserts
Render the reference pages: wiring, chrome, theming, a11y

payload.question: The spike fails NFR-002 (the plugin adds inline scripts). Waive or fall back?

payload.final_answer: Waive narrowly and keep starlight-openapi. API pages may add only the pinned plugin's known inline scripts; a gate pins their hashes and fails on any new one. Code samples are off (1 script). The how-to documents the hashes. Add the description adapter and the stylesheet filter. The ADR-0049 addendum records the waiver and moves it to Accepted.

payload.question: The default section 'api' collides with the agent API. What should the default be?

payload.final_answer: reference/api, so pages are at /reference/api/<label>/. A configured section is checked against reserved and authored routes.
